pkgmetadata.longdescription: Sqlectron is a simple and lightweight SQL client with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Cassandra and other databases. This package installs the official prebuilt Electron binary on amd64. On arm64, it reuses the upstream application bundle with matching upstream Linux arm64 Electron and SQLite binaries. Optional native SSH accelerators are omitted on arm64; the upstream JavaScript and WebAssembly fallbacks are used instead.
